open.title: A module's HTML KPI renders as bare inline text, with no tile
In the two-column grid, the two rows have different heights
On a phone, tabbing to the linked card leaves it partly under the right fade
The KPI row takes a Tab stop at desktop widths, where it does not scroll
kpi.js removes a class to end the loading state
The 'no value' dash has no translatable text for screen readers
In _kpi-row.scss a modifier comes after the breakpoints
The scrolling KPI row's focus ring is the browser's default outline, not Bootstrap's focus ring
Longest KPI title wraps to 3 lines and sets the values at different heights
Leftover flex rules on the KPI title from the removed tooltip
The KPI row's focus room hard-codes Bootstrap's focus ring width
The KPI's coloured top line hard-codes a width Bootstrap's border scale already has

outOfScope: Every Categories card gets data-ps-data-refresh-url on every load, even when its *_EXPIRE in ps_configuration_kpi is in the future: getKpi refetches all four values, the cache is never used and a cached empty value is never shown (check the expiry logic in HelperKpiTrait / the KPI adapters).
Top Category changes from one load to the next (Stationery, Art, Men, Clothes, Home Accessories): the ranking query seems to have no stable tie-break (TopCategoryKpi / AdminStatsController getKpi).
With 5 or more KPIs from actionCategoriesKpiRowModifier, the controller could pass the real count so the row picks a better arrangement than a lone fifth card wrapping.
